item.text: The SLA file defines Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 UTC, a May 26 holiday, and durations of 60/480/960 business minutes. Ticket 2 was reopened by the imported customer mail, so its SLA must restart at that comment—not its original creation—and the existing provisional due values need recalculation from this staged configuration.
